payload.summary: eval-retrieval can report success over zero golden fixture cases
payload.detail: scripts/eval-retrieval.ts:932-937 prepends captured DB cases to the golden fixture cases and then slice(0, limit) truncates FROM THE FRONT, so --limit 10 against 10 or more captured cases runs zero golden cases; a --query filter matching nothing yields zero cases outright. Either way summary.failed_cases is empty and the run exits 0 under --fail-on-threshold. The canary-pair comparator fails closed on a non-identical case set so the protocol is protected, but a standalone pre-merge run is not. FIX: fail when cases.length is 0, and require an explicit --allow-partial when limit or query would drop any golden case. Offline, no canary.
